title: The watchtower
goals: Do not let Dask see you.
Ask whether Dask can see you.
starting_code: # Ask which way Dask looks, and whether he can see you. Then walk on.
hints: `print(dask.facing)` shows on the card which way he looks.
intro: Hmph. A pupil in my passages. I am looking at the wall, not at you. Ask what I can see, if you like, and then walk on quietly.
